summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three new keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/: ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py and ServiceFargate.py. Added matching test modules test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 78 ECS tests pass, and 1016 tests in test/unit/rules plus the rule-collection and runner tests pass. Tests were run with PYTHONPATH=src because the venv's installed cfnlint points at a different checkout. Nothing is committed and no existing file was modified. Not verified: black/ruff formatting (neither is installed; line lengths checked by hand), test/unit/module/formatters (missing defusedxml in the venv), and the snapshot tests.
